description:
The Parivahan Scheme also known as the Government of India’s Green Bus and Clean Development Scheme (GBCDC) was launched in 2021. 

The primary objective of the Parivahan Scheme is to promote the use of electric and hybrid vehicles in public transportation. 

The scheme aims to reduce air pollution in urban areas by encouraging the adoption of clean energy vehicles. 

The government has set a target to deploy 10,000 electric buses across various cities in India by 2025. 

The initiative is part of the larger National Electric Mobility Mission Plan which was launched in 2013. 

The Parivahan Scheme is expected to contribute significantly to the reduction of carbon emissions. 

The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to state governments for the procurement of electric buses. 

Under the scheme, the government will provide a subsidy of up to 60 percent of the cost of electric buses. 

The maximum subsidy amount is capped at INR 1 crore per bus. 

This financial support is aimed at making electric buses more affordable for state transport undertakings. 

The scheme also includes provisions for the establishment of charging infrastructure for electric buses. 

The government plans to set up charging stations in strategic locations across cities. 

The objective is to ensure that electric buses have access to reliable charging facilities. 

Eligible beneficiaries under the Parivahan Scheme include state transport undertakings and private bus operators. 

To qualify for the subsidy, the buses must be registered as public transport vehicles. 

The buses must also comply with the specifications laid out by the Ministry of Heavy Industries and Public Enterprises. 

The application process for the Parivahan Scheme involves several steps. 

State transport undertakings must submit a proposal to the Ministry of Heavy Industries. 

The proposal must include details about the number of buses to be procured and the estimated cost. 

Additionally, applicants must provide a plan for the deployment of the buses in urban areas. 

Required documents include proof of registration as a public transport operator. 

Applicants must also submit a detailed project report outlining the operational plan for the buses. 

Once the proposal is approved, the subsidy amount will be disbursed to the state transport undertaking. 

The disbursement process typically takes place within three months of approval. 

The scheme is designed to be implemented in a phased manner. 

The first phase involves the deployment of 5,000 electric buses by 2023. 

The second phase aims to deploy the remaining 5,000 buses by 2025. 

The Ministry of Heavy Industries is the primary implementing authority for the Parivahan Scheme. 

The ministry is responsible for overseeing the application process and disbursement of funds. 

State transport departments will also play a crucial role in the implementation at the state level. 

The Parivahan Scheme is expected to create significant employment opportunities in the electric vehicle sector. 

It is estimated that the scheme will generate around 50,000 jobs in manufacturing and maintenance of electric buses. 

The initiative is also expected to stimulate the local economy by promoting the electric vehicle industry. 

The government has allocated INR 1,000 crores for the implementation of the Parivahan Scheme. 

This funding is part of the larger budget for the National Electric Mobility Mission Plan. 

The Parivahan Scheme aligns with India’s commitment to the Paris Agreement on climate change. 

The scheme is expected to reduce greenhouse gas emissions by approximately 1 million tons annually. 

The initiative also aims to improve air quality in urban areas, benefiting public health. 

The government has emphasized the importance of sustainable public transportation. 

The Parivahan Scheme is part of India's broader strategy to transition to a low-carbon economy. 

The scheme also supports the Make in India initiative by promoting domestic manufacturing of electric buses. 

The government encourages local manufacturers to participate in the supply chain for electric buses. 

The Parivahan Scheme is expected to enhance the overall efficiency of public transportation systems. 

By promoting electric buses, the scheme aims to reduce dependence on fossil fuels. 

The initiative also seeks to improve the reliability and comfort of public transport services. 

The government has set a timeline for regular monitoring and evaluation of the scheme’s progress. 

Periodic assessments will be conducted to ensure that targets are being met. 

The Parivahan Scheme is an important step towards achieving sustainable urban mobility in India. 

The initiative is expected to pave the way for future policies promoting electric vehicles. 

The government is committed to making public transport more accessible and environmentally friendly. 

The Parivahan Scheme represents a significant investment in the future of urban transportation. 

It is anticipated that the scheme will lead to a paradigm shift in how public transport is perceived and utilized. 

The initiative is also expected to foster innovation in the electric vehicle sector. 

By providing financial support, the government aims to encourage research and development in electric mobility. 

The Parivahan Scheme is a crucial component of India’s efforts to combat climate change. 

The initiative reflects the government’s commitment to sustainable development and environmental protection. 

The scheme is expected to create a cleaner and greener urban landscape for future generations. 

Overall, the Parivahan Scheme is a comprehensive approach to modernizing public transportation in India. 

It aims to address the pressing issues of pollution and urban congestion through innovative solutions. 

The scheme is a testament to the government’s vision of a sustainable and efficient transport system. 

The implementation of the Parivahan Scheme will require collaboration among various stakeholders. 

This includes government agencies, private operators, and manufacturers of electric buses. 

The success of the scheme will depend on effective coordination and commitment from all parties involved. 

The Parivahan Scheme is poised to make a lasting impact on the future of public transportation in India.
